propositions: Six high-churn, high-centrality modules sit within 7 lines of the 800 LOC size cap, with three at exactly 800 LOC, blocking new work from landing without structural refactoring.
llm/config.py has only 7 lines of headroom but 93 fan-in dependencies and 16 commits per 400, and a single new config knob costs 10–16 lines, making ordinary changes structurally infeasible.

The method from ADR 0056 (shape-based decomposition: extracting absorbing verbs, flattening declaration tables, or splitting colocated domains) successfully relieved runner.py from 689 to 647 LOC and must be applied to the next tier.

Seam tests asserting per-file headroom targets (< 700 for config.py, ≤ 560 for workflow_ops.py) and static guards for plan-review step registry membership and environment variable coverage are load-bearing substitutes for the rejected per-function length gate.

Relocation of mass from llm/config.py to gate_context.py (631 to 243 LOC extracted) and from workflow_ops.py to decide_ops.py (511 to 349 LOC extracted) removes blocking constraints without dissolving the underlying cost-per-knob absorption pattern.
